\section{Full simulation results}\label{sec:sims-supp}

This section gives every setting of designs S1 and S2 (Section~\ref{sec:sims}) for every measure of
Section~\ref{sec:sims-metrics}. Entries are averages over the $100$ data sets of a setting, except exact recovery,
which is a count out of $100$, and precision, which is averaged over the data sets with a non-empty selection and
shown as -- when there are fewer than $20$ of them.
